rationale: Playwright locator actionability regards aria-disabled=true as disabled, while the original button has no HTML disabled attribute and intentionally receives invalid-user-click feedback. Native coordinate tapping on the visible blocked tile leaves remaining tiles and selection unchanged. The stalled automation check alone is not a product release defect.

actual_next_action.description: Used the browser native touchscreen at the visible blocked tile center, then checked remaining and selection; no product change.
